title: Japan Family Odyssey | From City Lights to Autumn Delights
highlights: From Tokyo’s modern wonders to Kyoto’s timeless charm and Osaka’s lively streets, explore the best of Japan with your family and create unforgettable memories together.
Fly with Harry Potter, race with Mario, and meet Minions face-to-face as you explore Universal Studios, a magical world where your kids' favourite stories come alive.
March across the castle bridge like a warrior, explore towering stone walls, and step through the grand gates of Osaka Castle, famed for offering scenic views of Osaka from its top.
Explore Gotemba Premium Outlets, Japan’s largest luxury outlet, where you’ll find over 200 high-end brands, tasty food options, and scenic views of Mt. Fuji, Japan’s tallest peak.
Immerse yourself in Japan’s heritage with a stay at a Kyoto ryokan, where tatami floors, serene gardens, and sliding doors let you enjoy the country's traditional hospitality.

know_before_you_go: ID proof is mandatory for each guest at the time of booking and also upon arrival. PAN card will not be considered a valid address proof.
All international participants will have to share passport and visa details on arrival.
Learn basic Japanese phrases like "Konnichiwa" (hello) and "Arigatou" (thank you).
﻿﻿Remove your shoes when entering someone's house, a traditional house, or a temple in Japan.
Always remember not to leave chopsticks upright in a bowl of rice, as it's considered disrespectful.
Using your phone for calls during a train or bus journey is considered inappropriate etiquette in Japan.

The cancellation terms for any bookings or packages will be governed by the specific cancellation policy related to the land package. This means that any cancellations must adhere to the terms and conditions outlined in the land package's cancellation policy.

Thrillophilia's visa policy emphasizes that the company is not liable or responsible for any issues related to visa applications. This includes situations where a visa is rejected or delayed, or if there are any delays or errors in the documentation process. The responsibility and control over visa matters lie solely with the respective embassy.
Guests must note that entry ticket to Todai-ji Temple requires a separate fee of ¥600 per person, payable directly at the entrance.
For all the activities that have a designated common meet and drop point, guests are responsible for arranging their own transportation to and from the location.

Kindly note that hotel taxes range from JPY 500–1,000 per person per day for five-star hotels, JPY 200 per person per day for four-star hotels, and JPY 100 per person per day for three-star hotels and below.
Ensure your luggage does not exceed 160 cm in total dimensions to comply with size restrictions while travelling via bullet train.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome! Once you arrive at the airport, you'll be transferred to your hotel. After checking in, take some time to relax. Later, feel free to discover Tokyo at your own pace. You may wander Sumida Park, a popular location for viewing the Tokyo Skytree & enjoying the Sumida River or visit the Edo-Tokyo Museum, where life-size exhibits & detailed models showcase Tokyo's transformation from an Edo-era town to a modern city. For a fun twist, you can even go go-karting with Street Kart Tokyo Bay.

items.title: Check-in at Shinjuku Washington Hotel Annex

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Begin the day by reaching Love Sculpture, the pickup point for your transfer. Start with a visit to Meiji Jingu Shrine, dedicated to Emperor Meiji & Imperial Palace, the residence of Japan’s Emperor. Explore Sensoji Temple, city’s oldest Buddhist temple & Nakamise-dori Street, lined with shops of traditional souvenirs. Admire the towering Tokyo Skytree & Red Tokyo Tower, among other key landmarks. Later, get dropped off at Shinjuku St. (West Exit) & from there, return to the hotel on your own.

items.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour - Departure from Shinjuku LOVE Statue (With Lunch)

days.title: Trip to Mount Fuji, Hakone & Gotemba Outlets
days.desc: Today, make your way to Shinjuku Center Building to board the bus for a fun-filled full-day tour. Begin Mt. Fuji 5th Station, offering views of Fuji Five Lakes region. Next, enjoy shopping at Gotemba Premium Outlets, home to over 200 international brand stores. Continue with Hakone Ropeway ride, gliding above steaming sulphur fields & sail on a cruise across Lake Ashi aboard the Hakone Pirate Ship. Later, get dropped off at Shinjuku St. (West Exit) & from there, head to the hotel on your own.

items.title: Trip to Mt Fuji 5th Station, Hakone & Gotemba Outlets

days.title: Day at Leisure
days.desc: Take the day to explore the city on your own. You can marvel at the futuristic architecture of Mode Gakuen Cocoon Tower or witness a stunning management on road at Shibuya Crossing, the world’s busiest pedestrian junction. If you wish, you may visit Tokyo DisneySea, a unique Disney theme park featuring immersive themed ports & thrilling attractions. Alternatively, you can take in the scenic beauty of Nakayama Pass, a mountain route offering views of rolling landscapes & countryside scenery.

days.title: Day Trip to Disneyland
days.desc: Get ready for a magical day at Disneyland Tokyo, where excitement awaits at every turn. You can begin your adventure in Adventureland, sailing with daring pirates or cruising through lush jungle rivers. Alternatively, you may step into the storybook world of Fantasyland, home to classic rides like Peter Pan’s Flight, It’s a Small World, and the enchanting Cinderella Castle. Moreover, you can enjoy lively parades & captivating stage shows, ending your day with a fireworks show.

days.title: Transfer to Kyoto | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Check out & make your way to Shinjuku Station to board the iconic Shinkansen train to Kyoto. Travel at speeds of up to 320 km/h while enjoying a smooth ride & picturesque scenery. On arrival, proceed to the hotel & check in for a unique stay at a traditional Ryokan, offering an authentic taste of Japanese hospitality. Later, enjoy the rest of the day at your leisure & explore Kyoto Imperial Palace or wander through the charming Gion district, known for its geisha culture & wooden townhouses.

items.desc: 1 X Bullet Train (Shinkansen) will be Provided

items.title: Check-in at Kyoto Ryokan Gion Sano

days.title: Kyoto, Nara & Arashiyama Sightseeing Tour | Arashiyama Sagano Train Experience
days.desc: Today, get driven to Kyoto St. Exit & board the bus for a day of scenic trip. Explore Nara Park, where you can feed the free-roaming deer & Fushimi Inari Taisha, famous for its vivid red torii gates. Continue to Kyoto Station & take the train to Torokko Saga Station to enjoy a ride on Sagano Scenic Train, offering views of the Hozugawa River. Disembark at Arashiyama to stroll through the Bamboo Grove & marvel at the glowing pillars inspired by the traditional kimono fabrics of the Kimono Forest.

days.title: Transfer to Osaka | Osaka Walking Tour
days.desc: Check out & get driven to Kyoto St. to board the bullet train to Osaka. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel. Afterwards, head to Exit 2 of Tanimachi 4-Chome St. Wander through Osaka Castle, known for its beautiful gardens & Tsuruhashi, Japan's largest Korean town. Step back in time at Shinsekai, filled with colorful lanterns & Tennoji Ward, home to Abeno Harukas, Japan’s tallest non-tower building. Don't miss visiting Dotonbori, renowned for its bustling canalside & irresistible street food.

days.title: Day Trip to Universal Studios
days.desc: In the morning, get driven to Universal Studios Japan for a full-day adventure packed with excitement. Explore immersive zones like The Wizarding World of Harry Potter, Super Nintendo World, Minion Park, and Jurassic Park. Don’t miss heart-pounding rides such as Harry Potter and the Forbidden Journey and Mario Kart: Koopa’s Challenge. Also, explore other themed zones such as Hollywood, New York & Amity Village, each offering unique shows &delicious themed snacks. Later, get driven back.

days.title: Sakura Magic & Nabana no Sato Illumination Tour
days.desc: Today, head to Daikokucho Station & board the train to the Mainichi Newspaper Building. Upon arrival, enjoy a traditional sukiyaki lunch in Sekigahara before taking a scenic ride on the Yoro Railway through Japan’s countryside. Also, experience a peaceful rafting journey in Ogaki along canals offering stunning surrounding views. Later, visit Nabana no Sato, known for its vibrant flower gardens and Tunnel of Lights. Afterward, return to Osaka by train. Upon arrival, head to the hotel on your own.

items.title: Sakura Magic & Nabana no Sato Tour

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: After check-out, you'll be driven to Kansai International Airport for your flight back home. As your journey comes to an end, take a moment to reflect on the unforgettable experiences you've had. This is where your trip ends.
